notes.title: 【Update】Added new playable characters and BOSS RUSH system!
notes.content:
The game has been updated. Here are the details of this update: 


 New Playable Characters-Magi and Air： 
After completing the tutorial and choosing the initial Rice-Hime, you can switch between playable characters in the rebirth scene. Each character has unique traits and exclusive CG illustrations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/8a0049d127df60f1821d7f1c15f792605c168af4.jpg
 Boss Rush Challenge：
After clearing the game for the first time, you can select "Boss Rush" from the title screen to take on consecutive Boss battles with your cleared team.


To celebrate the update, enjoy a one-week limited-time discount! If you haven't picked it up yet, now is the perfect opportunity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/08eb09289833b6df611014c43dc9e5bf30b9ea32.jpg

Good luck to all trainers!
※Check the Steam version component ID (15087737) to confirm the update. If the update hasn't been applied, please use the "Verify Integrity of Game Files" feature.

notes.title: 【Update Preview 】"Sakura and the Airyvixen" will be updated at the end of July!
notes.content:
"Sakura and the Airyvixen"x is scheduled for a game update on July 24th (PT).

Here are the details of the upcoming update:


 New Playable Characters:
New characters, cultivator Magi and Air, will be added as playable characters. Each will have their own talents and ending illustrations.
 Boss Rush:
After clearing the game, you can select Boss Rush from the main screen to challenge bosses consecutively with your cleared team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/80051b28cf37e3ef938d5ac8a072334dd508e3c7.jpg

Stay tuned!

notes.title: 《Sakura And The Airyvixen》Demo is open for a limited time!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/4a657acd11b372180e3ee7c7fb85a967ae5912ee.jpg
《Sakura And The Airyvixen》A Turn-based Roguelite filled with bishoujo. Demo is open for a limited time, navigate through challenges with strategies and the power of dice! Demo is released for a limited time of 2 weeks.
The demo includes 3 stages with 7 playable characters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/b1beedf58d546f9f5a698bf88f5cc252b85b6009.png
Strategic Dice Battles
The game's combat revolves around dice rolling. Each turn your gain action points by rolling your dice, and you're able to attack until you use up your action points. There are also abilities that do bonus damage or rain debuffs on your enemies if you roll the right number. It's essential for you to form a game plan on top of relying on sheer luck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/93005ea109c183705b220b97fe0db293b42351dd.png
Roguelite Design:
You will get to pick a companion to join your team everytime you clear a stage, which will affect your playstyle. Every failed challenge on the other hand turns your temporary abilities into permanent ones to give you an edge for your next adventure!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848148/b3d1ec11616c93deee2fadd6e35f35d4b86102e4.png
This is the first time we developed a game of this genre, it's been a real challenge to us and we have spent a lot of time on adjusting the game due to design issue. We may not provide a comparable experience to those renowned titles but we hope to deliver a different kind of fun to you. :)

If you have any advice feel free to leave comments in the forum, not that we promise to address every issue(you know, for adult reasons), but we will make sure to read through all of your comments!

Lastly, don't forget to wishlist the game and follow our news!

Strategic Dice Battles
The game's combat revolves around dice rolling. Each turn your gain action points by rolling your dice, and you're able to attack until you use up your action points. There are also abilities that do bonus damage or rain debuffs on your enemies if you roll the right number. It's essential for you to form a game plan on top of relying on sheer luck.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/93005ea109c183705b220b97fe0db293b42351dd.png
Rougelite Design:
You will get to pick a companion to join your team everytime you clear a stage, which will affect your playstyle. Every failed challenge on the other hand turns your temporary abilities into permanent ones to give you an edge for your next adventure!
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/b3d1ec11616c93deee2fadd6e35f35d4b86102e4.png

If you have any advice feel free to leave comments in the forum, not that we promise to address every issue(you know, for adult reasons), but we will make sure to read through all of your comments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2710380/
A rougelite full of strategy, cultivation, and cute girls!
Our heroes are transported to a once-peaceful town consumed by chaos, and can't leave unless they... fight their way out!? Adventure together with a party of cuties and get to the bottom of all this craziness.
Dozens of Character Types:
Customize and cultivate a team of unique fighters, matching their strengths against enemy weaknesses in tense 3v3 battles!
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/71352e297b6049c7a943f287504fe07941347698.gif
Strategic Dice Battles:
Roll each character's unique set of dice to rack up action points, then spend those points on special moves and abilities! You'll have to use your points wisely if you want to defeat every new enemy in your path.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38186556/84b65574519620ac1277f1ba38c367b2375ac2c8.gif

Fight your way through a new map each time you play, forging your own path forwards. Will you choose to face powerful enemies for epic rewards, or take the easier, safer route? Each choice brings you one step closer to success... or failure!
